notes.title: Hot Slice – New Update Available!
notes.content:
Hello! 🎮 
We’re excited to bring you the latest update that addresses some important fixes and improvements! 💡

First, we’ve fixed the issue where the character (round gear) was spilling outside the screen. Now, everything stays neatly within the boundaries! 🔒 We’ve also added visible gray borders to make these boundaries clearer, so you’ll always know exactly where your game world ends. 🖥️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45270866/a97f5625a335024049b4b83f879c93845f766c58.gif[/img]

But that’s not all! 😎 We’ve also introduced zoom functionality, so now when you resize the game window, the game will automatically zoom in or out, allowing you to scale the game to your preferred resolution with ease. 🌐 Whether you like playing at a larger scale or prefer a more compact view, you can now adjust it to fit your needs! 📏

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45270866/9ce2f4858f670c0cb5f430e68d8f16dabd08719a.gif[/img]

This update is all about improving your gaming experience, and we can’t wait to hear what you think! 🗣️ Let us know your feedback in the comments and enjoy the new features! 🎉

Happy gaming, and see you in the game! 🚀

notes.title: Hot Slice: Lust Exposed Launches Tomorrow!
notes.content:
[b]The wait is over[/b]—[b]Hot Slice: Lust Exposed[/b] is launching [b]tomorrow[/b]! Get ready for a game that combines innovative mechanics with jaw-dropping [b]rewards[/b]. This isn’t your average adult game. Every cut brings you closer to uncovering bold, high-quality scenes, making every move more exciting than the last.

[i]What Makes Hot Slice: Lust Exposed Unique?[/i]

[h3]🔥 Steamy Visuals[/h3]
Get ready to experience stunning visuals that will leave you craving more. Every unlocked scene is a work of art, and every level reveals something even hotter.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45270866/7be266ddbfc2c0b83ddd2c05883ef111c19f6de0.gif[/img]

[h3]💥 Intense and Addictive Gameplay[/h3]
The cutting mechanic is unlike anything you’ve seen before—strategic and thrilling. Each move brings you closer to unlocking a new world of pleasure!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45270866/fecacde27fbf36b99aa4e1cbba70014f778d0924.gif[/img]

[h3]🎬 Exclusive Rewards[/h3]
As you progress, unlock sizzling rewards that raise the stakes. With 14 different scenes to uncover, each level promises new surprises. The more you play, the more you get!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45270866/152480b1d7de3500a4f82acceb0f62ec2c3626bb.gif[/img]

[h3]💥Don’t just take our word for it—check out a sneak peek of the game in action![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45270866/7028c1ff89aa65d3a35b7aa3ef20a44683addca6.gif[/img]


[b]Feel the intensity and heat with every move.[/b]
[b]Tomorrow[/b] is the day—Hot Slice: Lust Exposed is ready to take adult gaming to the next level. Get ready to unlock the ultimate experience. 🔥
